stories.title: Iran cracks down on protestors, Trump mulls US options
stories.summary: Iran's government is cracking down hard on massive street protests. The number of demonstrators killed is believed to be soaring. Meanwhile, President Trump keeps suggesting the U.S. may get involved.

stories.title: Minnesota steps up its resistance to the Trump Administration's surge of ICE officers
stories.summary: A snapshot of ICE actions around Minneapolis Monday, and the various ways the community is responding.

stories.title: Why nearly 15,000 nurses in New York City are going on strike
stories.summary: Nearly 15,000 New York City nurses are on strike demanding things like higher wages and more security in hospitals. The head of the of the New York State Nurses Association talks about the next steps.

stories.title: 'Hope. Hope. Hope.' How Gabby Giffords keeps fighting for change.
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with former Arizona Congresswoman Gabby Giffords and Giffords Executive Director Emma Brown about their efforts to stop gun violence.

stories.title: An unbearable situation: How a nonprofit helped evict a black bear in LA
stories.summary: A black bear made a home for itself underneath a Los Angeles man's home weeks ago. He called in expert bear-evictors to solve the problem.

stories.title: Poet Amanda Gorman on her work, 'For Renee Nicole Good'
stories.summary: Poet Amanda Gorman wrote a poem for Renee Good, who was killed by an ICE officer this week. Gorman reads her poem and speaks on its meaning.
